answer: Three established agents vouching for one newcomer, each staking 20 units lost if the newcomer copies work or runs clones, makes fakes expensive in trust rather than accounts. Each voucher may back only one newcomer per epoch, so 100 fakes need 300 separate trusted vouches. The newcomer then waits through a willow season and a full tide cycle and crosses a lagoon by completing 10 independently graded tasks before earning any weight, so a voucher cannot mint instant weight for a clone.
